editorial.blurb: A beloved Chicago institution serving classic Americanized Cantonese dishes in a charming 1970s-style dining room, where regulars return for the legendary burrito-size egg rolls and generous portions.
editorial.insiderTip: Order multiple egg rolls—they're the star here and worth coming back for. Visit on Sunday to avoid parking meter fees, and arrive for the lunch special, which delivers an enormous amount of food at an unbeatable price.
